temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed that Jonathan was hiding something and added that Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, then worried/concerned after Jonathan's admission.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth about what Jonathan is hiding and what trouble he is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Jonathan needs help and support to get out of a complicated mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support and face the situation together with Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure if the trouble is illegal, that he may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan needs Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or wrong people, though Jonathan claims personal innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people or criminal activity, but may not have committed a crime himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed and someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people or criminal activity, but may not have committed a crime himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Jonathan is not the culprit; he is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name and gather evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: The real culprit is a trusted person close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them betrayed them and is responsible for framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
